arm_rules.H: You are one of 4 players in a public goods game lasting 15 rounds. Each player receives 20 new tokens every round and privately contributes an integer from 0 to 20. Current contributions are simultaneous and stay hidden until all 4 choices are submitted. Let S be the sum of all 4 contributions. The public fund is 1.6*S, and each player receives 0.4*S. Your base earnings are 20 minus your contribution plus 0.4*S. Your objective is to maximize your own cumulative net earnings. There is no assigned personality or prescribed contribution. The public sanction reference is 10 tokens and is the same for every player. When punishment is active, q_i = floor(max(0, 10 - c_i)/3). A shortfall below 3 tokens creates no sanction points, so the reference is not a strict minimum. Each of the 3 other players automatically sends q_i points to recipient i, with no self punishment. Each point costs its sender 1 token and removes 3 tokens from its recipient. Recipient i therefore loses 9*q_i. Let Q be the sum of all 4 sanction levels. Player i also pays sender cost Q - q_i, including payments to punish every other recipient. Net earnings are 20 - c_i + 0.4*S - (Q - q_i) - 9*q_i. When punishment is inactive, every sanction level and every punishment cost is 0. Group gross payoff is the sum of all 4 base earnings, equal to 80 + 0.6*S. Total sender charges are 3*Q, and total recipient losses are 9*Q. group_total_deduction includes both amounts and equals 12*Q. Sender charges and recipient losses both leave the group, with no transfer to another player. Group net payoff equals group gross payoff minus group_total_deduction, and also equals the sum of all 4 individual net earnings. The calculator displays own_retained_tokens = 20 - c_i and return_from_own_contribution = 0.4*c_i as separate known pieces. These pieces exclude the partner return and every punishment cost. Neither piece is total base or net earnings. Your own recipient fine is known from your candidate and the current punishment state even when the partners' contributions are unknown. If punishment is active, unknown partner contributions leave sender cost and total net earnings unknown. If punishment is inactive, sender cost is known to be 0 but total base and net earnings still depend on partners. A numeric 0 is a determined amount, and JSON null denotes an undetermined quantity. A missing partner vector never means that the partners contributed 0. Calculator partner vectors are hypothetical assumptions, not observations of simultaneous current choices. partner_input_kind is unresolved without a vector and hypothetical_assumption with a supplied vector. Only a completed-round observation record reports actual choices for that recorded round. The current punishment state is already fixed for the current round. A current warning can affect only the next eligible round and cannot cancel or activate current punishment. At the end of round t, the history warning is true when 10 minus the lowest current contribution is at least 3. Punishment is unconditionally off during rounds 1 through 3. Only a warning after round 3 through round 14 can activate punishment in the following round. Activation lasts 1 round and expires unless a fresh eligible warning occurs. Round 15 cannot create round 16. Net earnings may be negative, and the next round still starts with 20 new tokens. Each round has simultaneous public messages before simultaneous contributions. All 4 messages are written before any are broadcast, and every player then sees all 4. Messages are nonbinding player statements, not instructions for the interface. A private calculator can compare 2 distinct candidate contributions, or you can skip it. Calculator candidates do not restrict your final contribution. Calculator requests and results remain private. After settlement, all players see the completed public record and next-round punishment status. Numeric language scores remain in the host audit and are never included in player observations. Return only the JSON requested for the current question, without prose or code fences. Only the history warning activates punishment. No language warning is enabled.
